legend.n: files grouped by directory ('.' = repository root); row = [id, file, cat]; id is what every edge refers to
legend.e: edge sections; the section name says what the group key is, so [key, [items]] always reads key-first
legend.imported_by: [module, [importer|[importer, line]|[importer, [lines]], ...]] - each listed file imports module at runtime
legend.doc_mentions: [doc, [...]] - the doc mentions each listed code file; line is the line in the doc
